credits.title: Extraordinary Tales
credits.overview: Five tales by Edgar Allan Poe come to life thanks to a pictorical style animation, five tales that exude madness, pestilence, murder and torture.

credits.title: The Fall of the House Of Usher
credits.overview: Narrated by Sir Christopher Lee as Roderick Usher summons his boyhood friend to help him ease his decaying condition. The death of Madeline Usher, last in the line of the Usher family precipitates Roderick's descent into madness and death.

credits.title: The Missing Lynx
credits.overview: An eccentric millionaire becomes obsessed with the idea of constructing a new Noah's Ark. He hires a hunter to kidnap untoward numbers of animals to make this happen. The group of animals amid their valiant attempt to escape from the hunter's clutches, foil his nefarious plans, and free their captured friends.

credits.title: Legend of the Paddle: The Oldie Hollis Story
credits.overview: Oldie Hollis is the world's oldest table tennis player in the world. He has been the champion for over 60 years but has he met his match this time around?
